mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(inquiry_no) FROM tb_inquiry WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND inquiry_delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, inquiry_status, inquiry_created FROM tb_inquiry WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND inquiry_delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY inquiry_created DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.startRowNum}

SELECT i.inquiry_no, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_status, i.inquiry_created, u.user_no, u.user_nickname FROM tb_inquiry i INNER JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_no = u.user_no WHERE i.inquiry_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY i.inquiry_created DESC LIMIT 5
